definitions.explanation: A temporary structure of metal poles and wooden planks used to support workers and materials during the construction, repair, or cleaning of buildings.
A place to stand securely, or figuratively, a stable position or foundation from which to work or proceed.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}で{足場|あしば}を{組|く}んでいる。
examples.english: They are setting up scaffolding at the construction site.

examples.japanese: {外壁|がいへき}{塗装|とそう}のために{足場|あしば}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Scaffolding is needed for painting the exterior walls.

examples.japanese: {足場|あしば}が{悪|わる}いので{気|き}をつけてください。
examples.english: Please be careful, the footing is bad.

examples.japanese: まずは{地元|じもと}で{足場|あしば}を{固|かた}めたい。
examples.english: First, I want to establish a solid footing locally.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
・{足|あし} (foot) + {場|ば} (place) → place to put one's feet

CONSTRUCTION CONTEXT:
・{足場|あしば}を{組|く}む (to set up scaffolding)
・{足場|あしば}を{解体|かいたい}する (to dismantle scaffolding)
・{単管|たんかん}{足場|あしば} (pipe scaffolding)
・{枠組|わくぐみ}{足場|あしば} (frame scaffolding)
・{足場|あしば}{工事|こうじ} (scaffolding work)

FIGURATIVE USAGE:
・{足場|あしば}を{固|かた}める (to establish a solid footing/base)
・{足場|あしば}が{悪|わる}い (unsteady footing - literal or figurative)
・{足場|あしば}を{失|うしな}う (to lose one's footing/position)

RELATED CONSTRUCTION TERMS:
・{脚立|きゃたつ} (stepladder)
・{梯子|はしご} (ladder)
・{高所|こうしょ}{作業|さぎょう} (high-altitude work)
